evidence.reason: makeManifest validates job.input, clones job.input into the stored manifest input, then hashes the original job.input again. For a plain object with an enumerable accessor, assertHashableInput, structuredClone, and hashInputs each invoke the getter independently, so the stored input snapshot and inputsHash can be derived from different values. That violates the function's stated guarantee that the committed hash is the hash of the input that will be dispatched, and assertHashableInput does not reject accessor properties.
